The '''Nallastian movement''' was an organization founded by a group of [[Fondorian]]s who left the [[Fondor Guild of Starshipwrights]] to protect [[Nallastia]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], against intensive exploitation. [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] [[Senator/Legends|senators]] supported the movement.
